mostWorthwhile.text: Checking the address against the handset was most worthwhile: it showed that a correctly read address can still be missing from the service directory.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final trolley-and-handset combination was less engaging because its purpose was unclear and it was the only offered action.

surprise.text: The handset read the address correctly but rejected it anyway; the signed receipt later made the contradiction tangible.

arbitrary.text: Pairing the working bell with the loaded trolley felt a little indirect, though Eli opening the gate explained its purpose afterward.

continue.text: Yes. The conflicting records make me curious how the neighborhood might challenge the directory, though the forced final combinations were less engaging.
